summary: Feed s131_double to IDS is degraded: 100% of packets missing required VLANs 10,20 (tags stripped) and 79.7% encrypted traffic exceeds 60% IDS tolerance, limiting payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP egress is stripping 802.1Q tags - 100% of packets arrive untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are not delivered. Typically caused by broker egress port set to access/untagged mode or SPAN stripping tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot segment or correlate traffic by VLAN 10/20, misses VLAN-based policy violations and lateral movement, reducing detection coverage for segmented assets.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve 802.1Q tags through the packet broker to the IDS so VLAN-aware rules and segmentation monitoring work.

findings.root_cause: 79.7% of bytes are encrypted (TLS), above the IDS 60% tolerance. Traffic is increasingly encrypted without a decryption/visibility point before the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload for signature matching but is blind to encrypted payloads; detection falls back to metadata only, missing exploits and C2 in encrypted flows.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payloads; advise decrypting relevant TLS flows via a visibility/decryption zone or forwarding to a tool with SSL inspection, or tuning to focus on decryptable traffic.
